verdict.rationale: Brevo documents a dedicated transactional email product for order confirmations and password resets. It also has its own transactional (SMTP) template endpoint and transactional event exports, which suggests transactional sending is a separate stream from marketing campaigns. Nothing in the pack shows separate suppression rules, separate sending reputation or IPs, or that transactional mail reaches contacts who unsubscribed from marketing. missing for 10: transactional-specific suppression/unsubscribe handling, separate sending reputation/IP isolation, explicit evidence receipts deliver to marketing-unsubscribed contacts, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, transactional email is kept separate from marketing — its own templates, suppression rules, and reputation — so a receipt still delivers to an unsubscribed contact
